`interface AudioGain`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.base.openal` · **Module:** `base-openal` · **Source:** [AudioGain.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/openal/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/openal/AudioGain.java)

A function that maps the gain and the audio group of a source to the volume sent to OpenAL.

## Description

A host returns the gain multiplied by its own volume for the group.
